items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Mike Abene... [INTERVIEWEE] I had a little problem with him reminding me of Lennie...

ctx.x: I’m going to [unintelligible] your memory in a minute but I don’t want to get ahead of us, I want to talk a little bit more about that. Do you remember much about playing at the Royal Roost? They’ve released the Boris Rose air checks.
Schwerin, yeah. Do you remember much about that gig, playing opposite Basie?
